name: jellyfin
description: Jellyfin integration for your self-hosted media server — search movies, shows, music, and episodes; inspect item metadata; list libraries; see recently added items and who is watching right now; get continue-watching / next-up episodes; and trigger metadata or library refreshes. Authenticates with a static admin API key sent in the modern Authorization: MediaBrowser header (Dashboard > API Keys). API keys are admin-scoped, so the tool set is read-only plus low-risk refresh/scan. Requires the server to be reachable from Sophon's sandbox (LAN-only or VPN-only instances need a reverse proxy or tunnel).
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: Jellyfin URL
fields.helpText: The URL of your Jellyfin server including port, without a trailing slash. Must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox — LAN-only or VPN-only instances need a reverse proxy or tunnel.

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Create one in Jellyfin under Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys. Note: Jellyfin API keys are admin-scoped (full server privileges) — this skill only reads and triggers refreshes.

fields.label: Default User ID
fields.helpText: Optional Jellyfin user ID used for continue-watching / next-up queries. Find it in the Dashboard > Users (the id in the URL) or from active session data.

tools.name: jellyfin.search_library
tools.description: Search across all libraries for movies, shows, episodes, or music by title. Optionally restrict to item types.

includeItemTypes.description: Comma-separated item types to restrict to, e.g. 'Movie,Series,Episode,Audio'

tools.name: jellyfin.get_item
tools.description: Get full metadata for one item (overview, genres, cast/crew, and media streams) by its id.

userId.description: Optional user id to fetch user-scoped fields; defaults to the connection card's default user

tools.name: jellyfin.list_libraries
tools.description: List the media libraries (virtual folders) with their collection types, plus overall item counts.

tools.name: jellyfin.get_recently_added
tools.description: List the most recently added items, optionally within one library.

parentId.description: Optional library/folder id to scope to (from jellyfin.list_libraries)

tools.name: jellyfin.get_active_sessions
tools.description: Show current playback sessions — who is watching what, on which client, and whether it is paused.

tools.name: jellyfin.get_next_up
tools.description: Get the continue-watching / next-up episodes for a user. Requires a user id (default_user_id or the userId parameter).

userId.description: User id; defaults to the connection card's default user

tools.name: jellyfin.refresh_item_metadata
tools.description: Trigger a metadata refresh for one item.

tools.name: jellyfin.scan_library
tools.description: Trigger a full library scan on the server.
